title: IFC entity
description: The IFC entity a node came from: what it is, how the file identified it, and every direct attribute that carries a value of its own. Attributes that point at other lines are not here -- those become links between nodes.

ifcType.description: The IFC class, spelled as the schema spells it: IfcWall, IfcBuildingStorey.

expressId.description: The line number the entity had in the file it was read from. Unique within that file and meaningless outside it.

globalId.description: IfcRoot.GlobalId, the 22-character identifier IFC intends to be unique everywhere. Absent on entities that are not rooted, such as IfcMaterial.

longName.description: The longer name a spatial element or project carries.

tag.description: IfcElement.Tag, normally the mark the authoring tool assigned.

predefinedType.description: The PredefinedType enumeration label, such as SOLIDWALL.

attributes.description: Every other direct attribute that holds a value, keyed by its IFC attribute name. Ownership, placement and representation attributes are left out: the first says nothing about the thing, and the other two are already the node's transform and mesh.
